summary: Phase B7-B11 backend modularization regression testing - 37/37 tests PASS (100%). Verified byte-identical behaviour for B7 Dashboards, B8 Reports route registration, B9 Super-admin (~91 routes) + Platform Config (units/fuel-database/scope3-ef/sectors/gwp-config/currency-conversion/formula-*/emission-configurations/emission-factors/calculation-formulas/process-templates), plus in-process smoke for B10 Category Registry and B11 EventBus. critical_code_review_comments: [B9 REFACTOR - REGRESSION FOUND + FIXED] GWP_VALUES and GWP_DEFAULT_SOURCE constants used in 12 places in modules/superadmin/router.py (lines 1250-1256, 1424-1434, 2393-2394, 2482-2483) were never lifted from server.py. This caused GET /api/gwp-values to 500 with NameError, and would have broken default GWP fallback in POST /super-admin/gwp-config and 2 calculation-formula seeding paths whenever the active gwp_config DB row is missing. Fix is byte-identical: 5-line constants block from server.py L830-838 added after `router = APIRouter()`. Strong recommendation: extract this kind of module-level constant into shared/constants/gwp.py to avoid duplication across server.py + router.py.

[B9 ROUTER SIZE] modules/superadmin/router.py is 2511 lines - WAY beyond the 700-line guideline. Should be split into at least 6 sub-routers (organizations, admins, units+fuels, scope3-ef, gwp+currency, formulas+emission-factors, sectors+process-templates).

[B9 IMPORT HYGIENE] router.py top imports `from cascade_delete import cascade_delete_organization` and `from r2_storage import get_r2_storage` without a package prefix - these rely on /app/backend being on sys.path. Future packaging may break this.

[B11 API ERGONOMICS] EventBus method naming is slightly inconsistent: `subscribe`/`unsubscribe` vs `on` (decorator) vs `emit`/`emit_nowait` vs `clear` (clears ALL handlers, takes no args). The .clear() not accepting an event_name is a minor surprise; consider .clear(event_name=None) for symmetry with unsubscribe.

[B10 REGISTRY - POSITIVE] category_registry singleton has clean public API (all/by_scope/get/has/has_capability) and 25 descriptors - good lift from frontend categoryRegistry. Used dataclass + frozenset for capability flags which is exactly right.

rca_of_the_issue: GWP_VALUES NameError 500 on /api/gwp-values: Phase B9 lift-and-shift moved ~91 routes from server.py into modules/superadmin/router.py but missed lifting two module-level constants (GWP_VALUES dict and GWP_DEFAULT_SOURCE string) defined at server.py lines 830-838. The router body references these names at 12 call sites (lines 1250,1253,1256,1424,1425,1431,1432,1433,1434,2393,2394,2482,2483). Python resolved them at function-call time, found nothing in the router module's globals, and raised NameError caught by FastAPI as HTTP 500. Mitigation applied: 8-line constant declaration added after `router = APIRouter()` with byte-identical values. Verified by GET /api/gwp-values returning {CO2:1, CH4:27.9, N2O:273, source:'IPCC AR6', time_horizon:'100-year'} as expected. Long-term fix: relocate GWP constants to shared/constants/gwp.py and import from both server.py (legacy) and modules/superadmin/router.py to eliminate the duplication risk.
